items.headline: Sources: Patriots QB Maye expected out extended time with significant leg injury
items.description: Patriots QB Drake Maye is believed to have suffered a significant lower leg injury that will keep him out an extended period of time, possibly the rest of the season, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
